description: This file defines a custom exception class InstallmentNotFoundException that extends a platform-specific base exception. It is used to indicate that a specific installment associated with a transaction ID was not found.

classes.name: InstallmentNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception class used to signify that an installment was not found for a given transaction ID.

methods.name: InstallmentNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message indicating the invalid transaction ID.
